battleTraits.name: Concealing Tide
battleTraits.effect: Concealing Tide (Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase): For the rest of the battle round, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target friendly Idoneth Deepkin units that did not use any Charge abilities in the same turn.

battleTraits.name: Swift Tide
battleTraits.effect: Swift Tide (Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase): For the rest of the battle round, friendly Idoneth Deepkin units can use Run abilities and still use Shoot and/or Charge abilities later in the turn.

battleTraits.name: Sea's Embrace
battleTraits.effect: Sea's Embrace (Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase): Friendly Idoneth Deepkin units have Strike-first for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Unpredictable Tide
battleTraits.effect: Unpredictable Tide (Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase): Remove the target from the battlefield and set it up again wholly within 7" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battleTraits.name: Inexorable Tide
battleTraits.effect: Inexorable Tide (Once Per Battle Round, Any Hero Phase): Subtract 1 from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target friendly Idoneth Deepkin units for the rest of the battle round.

battleTraits.name: Storm's Wrath
battleTraits.effect: Storm's Wrath (Once Per Battle Round, Your Hero Phase): Friendly Idoneth Deepkin units' melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: Twin Tides
battleTraits.effect:
Twin Tides (Once Per Turn(Army), Reaction: You declared an Attack ability for a friendly Akhelian unit): Pick a visible friendly Namarti unit that has not used an Attack ability this phase to be the target.
• If this unit used a Shoot ability, immediately after the Shoot ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a Shoot ability as if it were your shooting phase.
• If this unit used a Fight ability, immediately after the Fight ability used by this unit has been resolved, the target can be picked to use a Fight ability. If the target does so, for the rest of the phase, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of its weapons but all of its attacks must target enemy units that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by this unit's attacks.

artefacts.name: Lifekelp Pod
artefacts.effect: Lifekelp Pod: Any Movement Phase Heal (D3) each friendly Idoneth Deepkin Cavalry unit within this unit's combat range.

artefacts.name: Dritchleech
artefacts.effect: Dritchleech: Subtract 1 from casting rolls for enemy Wizards while they are within 18" of this unit. In addition, each time an enemy spell fails, after that ability has been resolved, Heal (1) this unit

artefacts.name: Armour of the Cythai
artefacts.effect: Armour of the Cythai: If this unit has not charged this turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for combat attacks made by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Form of the Fangmora
heroicTraits.effect: Form of the Fangmora: If the unmodified hit roll for an attack that targets this unit is 1-3, the attack fails and the attack sequence ends.

heroicTraits.name: Nightmare Legacy
heroicTraits.effect: Nightmare Legacy: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 6" of this unit.

heroicTraits.name: Hunter of Souls
heroicTraits.effect:
Hunter of Souls: Pick 1 of the following weapon abilities for this unit's melee weapons to have
this battle:
• Anti-Cavalry (+1 Rend)
• Anti-Infantry(+1 Rend)
• Anti-Monster(+1 Rend)

heroicTraits.name: Endless Sea-Storm
heroicTraits.effect:
Endless Sea-Storm: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase If this unit is a Wizard, add 1 to its power level for the rest of the turn. If this unit is not a Wizard, it gains Wizard (1) for the rest of the turn.
In addition, add 2 to the next casting roll or banishment roll for this unit this turn.

heroicTraits.name: Merciless Raider
heroicTraits.effect: Merciless Raider: Any Combat Phase If this unit is within 6" of a damaged enemy unit, this unit can move 6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units but must end that move in combat with a damaged enemy unit.

heroicTraits.name: Lord of Storm and Sea
heroicTraits.effect: Lord of Storm and Sea: Each time an ability returns at least 1 slain model to a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit, after that ability has been resolved, you can return 1 additional slain model to it.

heroicTraits.name: Abyssal Dweller
heroicTraits.effect:
Abyssal Dweller: Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase Pick an objective within 18" of this unit to be the target. For the rest of the battle, while enemy units are contesting the target objective:
• Subtract the current battle round number from those units' Move characteristic.
• Those units cannot use Run, Retreat or Charge abilities

heroicTraits.name: Cursed Lineage
heroicTraits.effect: Cursed Lineage: End of Your Turn Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. Roll a number of dice equal to your opponent's fury level. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

heroicTraits.name: Adherent of Kir-Nadarr
heroicTraits.effect:
Adherent of Kir-Nadarr: Your Hero Phase Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. You can spend 1 rage dice. If you do:
• Apply the effect below.
• If your opponent's fury level is lower than yours, they must increase their fury level by 1, to a maximum of 7. 
Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
For the rest of the turn, ignore negative modifiers to hit rolls and wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly Idoneth Deepkin units that target that enemy unit.

battleFormations.name: Soul-raid Ambushers
battleFormations.effect: Fade Like Mist: When using the 'Unpredictable Tide' ability, you can pick up to 2 eligible targets instead of 1.

battleFormations.name: Namarti Corps
battleFormations.effect: Surge Forward: You can re-roll run rolls and charge rolls for friendly Namarti units while they are wholly within 12" of a friendly Akhelian unit.

battleFormations.name: Isharann Council
battleFormations.effect: Wisdom of the Deep: Add 1 to casting rolls, Isharann ritual rolls and lurelight rolls for friendly Isharann units while they are within the combat ranges of any other friendly Isharann units

battleFormations.name: Akhelian Beastmasters
battleFormations.effect: Ferocious Predators: Add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made with Companion weapons by friendly Akhelian units.

battleFormations.name: Deep-Sea Stalkers
battleFormations.effect:
Outflank the Enemy: While a friendly Idoneth Deepkin unit is wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge:
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target that unit if it has not charged this turn.
• Add 2" to the Move characteristic of that unit.

battleFormations.name: Ethersea Predators
battleFormations.effect: Blood in the Water: End of Any Turn If any friendly or enemy units were destroyed this turn, pick a friendly Akhelian Allopex unit that has been destroyed to be the target. Set up a replacement unit identical to the target wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.
